root = Stack([header, explanation, graph])
header = Card([CardHeader("Auth DB Failure Cascade", "Dependency impact and failure order")])
explanation = Card([Callout("warning", "Initial failure", "auth-db fails first. auth-service then fails, followed by its dependents in dependency order. Independent dependencies such as fraud-check and search-index are not affected by auth-db alone.")])
graph = Card([GraphViewer(nodes, edges, "auth-db")])
nodes = [
  {id: "auth-db", label: "1. auth-db", status: "fails"},
  {id: "auth-service", label: "2. auth-service", status: "fails"},
  {id: "session-cache", label: "3. session-cache", status: "fails"},
  {id: "api-gateway", label: "4. api-gateway", status: "fails"},
  {id: "admin-console", label: "3. admin-console", status: "fails"},
  {id: "checkout", label: "5. checkout", status: "fails"},
  {id: "payments", label: "Independent: payments", status: "ok"},
  {id: "fraud-check", label: "Independent: fraud-check", status: "ok"},
  {id: "search", label: "5. search", status: "fails"},
  {id: "search-index", label: "Independent: search-index", status: "ok"},
  {id: "notifications", label: "6. notifications", status: "fails"},
  {id: "reporting", label: "4. reporting", status: "fails"}
]
edges = [
  {from: "auth-service", to: "auth-db", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "session-cache", to: "auth-service", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "api-gateway", to: "auth-service", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "api-gateway", to: "session-cache", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "checkout", to: "api-gateway", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "checkout", to: "payments", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "payments", to: "fraud-check", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "search", to: "api-gateway", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "search", to: "search-index", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "admin-console", to: "auth-service", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "notifications", to: "checkout", label: "depends on"},
  {from: "reporting", to: "admin-console", label: "depends on"}
]
